_notes: plan: kept 'paket' (established across sv common/student/marketing); 'stödpaket', 'plan' and 'byta plan' unified to it (mobile:v3.home.noCounselor, student:v29.services.legacyContract, mobile:v29.plan.upgradePending). Owner: 'paket' is the natural Swedish term although the glossary's Avoid column lists 'package' for English.

consultation: 'konsultation' everywhere; 'rådgivningssamtal'/'rådgivning' (= advising, glossary Avoid) replaced in dashboard.counselor.nextCall, messages.call, v15 scope/allowance, v17 upgrade, v22 checkout, v29.plan.supportUntil. Diagnostic consultation = 'Kartläggningskonsultation'.

team: student copy says 'Hangyul-teamet'; the label 'Hangyul Univ team' is 'Hangyul Univ-teamet' (not 'Teamet Hangyul Univ' / 'Ditt Hangyul-team'). Four mobile strings said 'din rådgivare' where English says the Hangyul team; changed.
verification: student-facing checks are 'kontrollera'/'granska'; 'verifiera' kept only for account codes, MFA and the agency's explicit Verify action (mobile:agency.reviews.verify, v3.reviews.*).

admission offer = 'antagningsbesked'; standard admission letter = 'standardantagningsbrev' (mobile:v3.visa.beforeBody, student:v22.home.appTeam.letter, appStatus, offer steps). Owner: sv common/student elsewhere use 'antagningsbevis' for the letter; align those files.

managed application = 'Ansökningar vi sköter tillsammans med dig' in all allowance/feature keys; essay = 'uppsats' (majority usage), personal statement = 'personligt brev', mock interview = 'provintervju', visa document preparation = 'förberedelse av visumdokument'.
deadline: application deadline = 'sista ansökningsdag'; generic/task deadlines = 'deadline' (natural Swedish loan) instead of the stilted 'sista dagar'.

mobile:signup.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary added disclosure claims not in English; aligned to the web wording. PRIVACY.summary 'en hash av lösenordet' aligned to English 'password (stored encrypted)' in both apps - owner/legal to confirm.
mobile:app.* keep product names unchanged (Hangyul Agency / Hangyul Univ / Hangyul University); requires --allow-same.
University staff strings address the institution as 'ert universitet' / 'ni' (institutional plural) while the user remains 'du'.
